segments: "Make your configuration ‘modern and portable’." This guide walks you through migrating from a traditional /etc/nixos/configuration.nix to Flakes.
Create a dedicated configuration directory (such as ~/nixos-config). Do not make ad hoc changes directly inside /etc/nixos.
Because the Flake uses nixpkgs.lib.nixosSystem, you may need to adjust the top-level arguments in your existing configuration.nix:

Note: In Flake mode, when a Flake is read from a local Git working tree, the files it references must be tracked by Git (you can git add new files first). Explicit path: sources behave differently. Inspect the staged contents first to avoid including private keys or unrelated files.
No dependence on a global Channel: The system version is determined entirely by flake.lock.
Easy to back up: Simply push this directory to GitHub.
Modular configuration: You can easily split the configuration into files such as desktop.nix and user.nix, then reference them in configuration.nix under imports.
A successful build proves only that the build stage works. After activation, check the current system generation, service status, and desktop behavior before proceeding with Home Manager integration.
